_doc: Hand-curated extras for module_schema. `description` overrides the auto-detected one. `parallel` lists groups of #defines that must have the same number of elements and are edited together as one table. Column fields: define, label, type (pin/hex/string/enum/number/flag/bool), options (explicit enum values).

ads1115.description:
16-bit, 4-channel I2C ADC (Texas Instruments ADS1115 / ADS1015). Each channel can read a single-ended voltage; the raw code is converted by the ReSender formula module.

Mode:
  0 — raw code (adc.0..3)
  1 — single scaled value
  2 — signed/unsigned pair (.u.)
  3 — alternative reporting

tac11xx.description: RS-485 master for TAC-11xx / KWS-303L energy/water meters. Up to TAC11xx_MAX_CNT devices, polled every TAC11xx_READ_PERIOD ms. Each slot is addressed by one of TAC11xx_DEFAULT_ADDRS and declared with its device type + requested parameter mask.

kws_306l.description: RS-485 master for KWS-306L series meters. Up to KWS306L_MAX_CNT devices on the shared RS-485 bus; each slot is polled every KWS306L_READ_PERIOD ms.

counter.description: Interrupt-driven pulse counter. Each counter has its own pin and runs independently: pulses are summed, saved periodically, and converted to a rate (e.g. L/min, cpm) via per-counter divisors. Every column below is a parallel array — one entry per counter, in the same order.

analog.description: Direct ADC input on one or more pins. Each pin gets its own name and raw value.

didgi_clock.description: 7-segment digit display driven by individual GPIO lines (DIDGI_PINS lists the pins).
